note: In the ledger, `sources` holds indices into `sources` below, and method fields hold indices into `methods`.
methods: County subdivision own GEOID county prefix; for places whole original valid polygon covered by exactly one valid same-COUNTYNS ACS2024 county polygon; exact/official-suffix county name match

Invariant v4.0/master integer population >=100 equals one and only one same-name same-state Census unit in Census 2000 or 2010, across all candidate editions within 25km; present in 2024 by same GEOID or official CT crosswalk; own polygon proximity/containment and no other-unit own-item codes; same-entity 2020 P1 total

Own Census 2020 or ACS2024 polygon; invalid polygon containment-only make_valid with <2 percent ellipsoidal area gate; local WGS84 azimuthal-equidistant distance from stored point; MCD must cover point, place must be <=5000m away
WGS84 ellipsoid; pyproj.Geod; absolute shell areas minus absolute hole areas, independent of invalid ring orientation; exclude nonpolygon remnants

interpretation: Candidate set is the union of same-name same-state places and county subdivisions within 25km of their official internal points in any retained edition (2000, 2010, 2020, 2024); all retained historical counts of each included unit enter the tie test, even if an older internal point moved beyond 25km. No dummy/nonfunctioning unit is removed from the equality tie test. Count equality, not a nearest or similar population, establishes legacy identity. Held rows are absent from compact ledger.
